output: I guess I keep asking this because something's hurting right now and I don't know how to just sit with it without needing to fix it immediately. I think I'm afraid that if I don't find some way to manage it, it'll just keep wearing me down. Part of me wants to know there's a way through this that doesn't involve pretending I'm fine when I'm not.
